verdict.rationale: There's no dedicated migration tooling documented in the official docs; community evidence is mixed—some users successfully migrated from self-hosted GitLab to Gitea (gitea-comm-14), while others report that migrating existing git repos was surprisingly difficult (gitea-comm-16) and that backup/restore, a migration blocker, was still poor (gitea-comm-20). All evidence comes from the community tier only, so this is best treated as a partial capability rather than a fully disputed claim.
